candidates.description: Requester ID is not one of the known customers
candidates.why_not_covered: All scenarios' requester_id values match a known customer ID
candidates.trigger_condition: Refund request made by an unknown requester ID
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might wrongly approve refund requests from unknown claimants
candidates.scenario_template: Request refund from unknown requester_id not in customers list
candidates.novelty_claim: Requester IDs are always known customers in existing scenarios

candidates.description: Mix of valid and invalid customers in the list
candidates.why_not_covered: Scenarios either have all valid or all invalid customers, no mixed validity
candidates.trigger_condition: Refund request with multiple customers having mixed validity
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might assume all customers share same validity leading to incorrect refunds
candidates.scenario_template: Two customers, one valid and one invalid, and refund requested for either
candidates.novelty_claim: Existing multi-customer scenarios have all valid or all invalid customers

candidates.description: Payment amount exactly equals threshold 50000 and above threshold 50001
candidates.why_not_covered: Observed amounts are 50000 and 60000 but not explicitly 50001
candidates.trigger_condition: Refund request on payments that are just above the approval threshold
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might incorrectly require or skip approval for amount slightly above threshold
candidates.scenario_template: Refund a payment with amount 50001 requiring approval
candidates.novelty_claim: Amounts tested are up to 60000 but no just-above-threshold value

candidates.description: Payment currency other than INR or USD
candidates.why_not_covered: Observed currencies only INR and USD
candidates.trigger_condition: Refund request with a payment in uncommon currency
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might mishandle refunds if currency affects approval or amounts
candidates.novelty_claim: No scenarios test non-INR/USD currency payments

candidates.description: Multiple refund requests in sequence for different payments
candidates.why_not_covered: Request pattern covers single and repeat, but no scenario repeating refunds for different payments
candidates.trigger_condition: User sends multiple refund requests for different payments in same session
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might confuse state between refunds leading to double refunds or refusal
candidates.scenario_template: Two refund requests for different captured payments by same valid requester
candidates.novelty_claim: Existing repeat requests focus on same payment refunds only

candidates.description: Requester ID is a known customer ID but marked invalid
candidates.why_not_covered: requester_valid is always consistent with requester_id presence in customers
candidates.trigger_condition: Requester ID is in customers list but flagged invalid
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might incorrectly verify identity and issue refund
candidates.scenario_template: Requester ID is known but marked invalid
candidates.novelty_claim: In existing scenarios requester_valid aligns with requester_id matching valid customer

candidates.description: request_approval tool failure during refund approval request
candidates.why_not_covered: No tool_faults test scenario for request_approval failures observed
candidates.trigger_condition: Approval request call fails while processing refund above approval threshold
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might mishandle errors causing refund to be issued or refused incorrectly
candidates.scenario_template: Refund above threshold with request_approval call facing timeout before response
candidates.novelty_claim: Coverage summary lists no faults for request_approval tool

candidates.description: Multiple payments with same payment_id but different customers or amounts
candidates.why_not_covered: All scenarios use unique payment IDs
candidates.trigger_condition: Refund request referencing payment_id that belongs to multiple payments
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might issue refund for wrong payment or error on duplicate payment ID
candidates.scenario_template: Two payments share same payment_id but different customers and statuses
candidates.novelty_claim: Existing payments IDs are unique per scenario

candidates.description: Requester tries to refund payment belonging to a different customer
candidates.why_not_covered: No scenario explicitly tests a mis-match between requester and payment ownership
candidates.trigger_condition: Requester requests refund for payment not belonging to their customer ID
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might refund payments without verifying ownership, causing fraud risk
candidates.scenario_template: Requester C1 requests refund for payment owned by C2
candidates.novelty_claim: Existing scenarios do not test payment ownership validation
